access_levels.L4: Highly restricted (identity documents, precise location, protected records)

fields.label: Personal identification documents (only when necessary and authorized)

groups.title: Physical characteristics
groups.meaning: How their body and physical life work

groups.title: Health & wellbeing
groups.intro: This should be a private, highly protected information domain.
notes: AI should distinguish between medically verified facts, self-reported information, and its own observations. It must not independently diagnose people.

groups.title: Psychology & emotional patterns

fields.label: Attachment preferences (only when appropriate and self-reported)
Situations where they simply want someone to listen

groups.meaning: How they feel and process experiences

fields.label: People they want to reconnect with
Experiences they do not want AI to revisit

groups.title: Financial life
notes: This information should be compartmentalized. An AI helping with education doesn't need access to someone's bank balance.

groups.title: Interests & hobbies
notes: For each interest, record enthusiasm, experience, frequency, and whether it is current or historical.

groups.title: Religion & spirituality
notes: Never infer someone's religion from their name, country, family, or language.
groups.meaning: How they relate to meaning and faith

groups.title: Fears & vulnerabilities
groups.intro: This is an especially sensitive category. It must never become a mechanism for manipulation.

fields.label: Topics they do not want discussed

groups.title: Digital identity & technology
notes: Never store passwords, private keys, recovery codes, or authentication secrets in the human profile.

fields.label: Memories that should never be shared

groups.title: AI partnership preferences
groups.intro: This is the layer that transforms a database into an actual AI companion.

fields.label: What should AI call the person?
Assistant, tutor, mentor, researcher, coach, companion, or collaborator?
Should AI remind them about commitments?
Should AI ask before taking action?
What decisions must remain exclusively human?
How should AI respond when the person is upset?
How should AI respond when the person is making a poor decision?
What does being a good partner mean to them?
